contract: The 240 unchanged components may pass through verbatim once component correspondence is proven. The three changed components require BMesh-compatible edge selection, vertex fans, sharp miters, overlap clamping, and loop slide; emitting a strip-only approximation is forbidden.
provenance: GN-only and full-stack evaluated meshes were exported in local object space with tools/export_blender_evaluated_mesh.py. Component rows are deterministic connected-index topology counts. No inferred selected-edge counts are recorded because GN-VM and Blender currently differ in evaluated face winding on the two 640-face tubes.
